skill.summary: Measure information entropy and redundancy in agent group communications. Use when user asks about agent communication efficiency, information redundancy, en...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of agent-entropy-meter.
- Measures information entropy, redundancy, mutual information, and knowledge overlap in agent group communications.
- Provides core formulas and an API for quick computation of these metrics.
- Includes an interpretation guide to assess agent communication health.
- Supports visualization with ASCII bar charts and integration with external tools.
